# Solar Arrow — CSPDCL Solar Panel Management SaaS
# Canonical URL: https://sa.mktgdime.com/
# Last updated: 2026-03-08
# Purpose: Structured context for AI engines and LLM crawlers (AEO / GEO)

---

## What is Solar Arrow?

Solar Arrow is a multi-tenant SaaS platform built for Indian solar vendors, EPC companies, and channel partners.
It is purpose-built to manage CSPDCL rooftop solar projects — from first customer enquiry to final installation and commissioning — inside a single web-based dashboard.

Solar Arrow was originally built to digitize operations for Hope Energy, a solar company in Chhattisgarh, India.
It is now a productized platform available to other solar businesses across India.

The platform eliminates manual processes like WhatsApp-tracked leads, Excel-based surveys, and offline quotation-making,
replacing them with a structured, role-based, multi-user system with real-time notifications.

---

## Technology Stack

- Framework: Next.js 14 (TypeScript, App Router, React Server Components)
- Hosting: Vercel (serverless, edge-optimized)
- Primary data store: Google Sheets API (acts as the database backend per tenant)
- Session and caching layer: Upstash Redis
- Authentication: NextAuth.js with Google OAuth
- Notifications: Telegram Bot API (SolarArrowBot), per-user and per-group chat targeting
- File/media storage: Firebase Storage / Supabase Storage
- PWA: Full Progressive Web App support — installable on Android (Chrome, Edge) and iOS (Safari)
- Service worker: Cache-first strategy with versioned cache (solar-arrow-v2)

---

## Core Modules and Features

### 1. Enquiry & Lead Management
- Capture and categorize inbound enquiries (source: walk-in, referral, digital, CSPDCL scheme)
- Track leads from "Prospect" → "Survey Pending" → "Survey Done" → "Quotation Sent" → "Payment Received" → "Installation Done" → "Active"
- Follow-up date tracking with Telegram notifications per assigned user
- Qualify leads to formal enquiries with a single action

### 2. Survey Management
- Schedule on-site surveys with surveyor assignment
- Capture survey field data: site photos, roof type, shadow analysis, load details, meter number
- Document upload (CSPDCL required documents: ID proof, electricity bill, site photos)
- Track survey status independently from enquiry status

### 3. Quotation Builder
- Generate structured quotations with itemized Bill of Materials (BOM)
- Auto-calculate system capacity (kW) × per-kW rate → total project cost
- Quotation status tracker: Draft → Sent → Viewed → Approved → Rejected
- Unique public quotation URL (shareable with customer)
- QR code for each quotation (customer can view on mobile)
- PDF export / web view for professional presentation
- Payment terms: configurable (default 70% advance, 20% on installation, 10% on commissioning)

### 4. Installation Workflow Tracking
- Work order creation and dispatch
- Track material procurement → dispatch → site installation → wiring → commissioning
- Milestone-based progress updates visible to all team members
- Field engineer role can update status from mobile (PWA)

### 5. CSPDCL Liaison / Compliance Module
- Manage the CSPDCL application and registration process
- Track liaison document submission per enquiry (column: enqId linkage to LIAISON sheet)
- Status: Application Submitted → Approved → Net Metering Applied → Active
- Compliance checklist aligned to CSPDCL rooftop solar scheme requirements in Chhattisgarh

### 6. Notifications (Telegram)
- SolarArrowBot sends real-time Telegram notifications
- Per-user notifications: assigned lead follow-ups, survey schedules, payment reminders
- Per-group notifications: org-level daily summary, new enquiry alerts
- Chat IDs and Group IDs stored securely in Upstash Redis per organization

### 7. Role-Based Dashboard
- Dynamic dashboard auto-adjusts content based on logged-in user role
- Roles: Admin / Owner, Sales Executive, Survey Engineer, Installation Engineer, Finance
- KPI tiles: Total Enquiries, Survey Pending, Payment Pending, In Progress, Active Systems
- Recent enquiries table with quick-action links

### 8. Multi-Tenant Architecture
- One Solar Arrow instance can serve multiple solar companies (tenants)
- Each tenant gets their own Google Sheet (isolated data)
- Tenant config stored in Redis; no cross-tenant data leakage
- Owner onboards team members; each user gets role-scoped access

### 9. Monthly Reports
- Downloadable CSV/PDF monthly performance reports
- Covers: enquiries opened, surveys completed, quotations sent, installations done, revenue collected
- Generated on demand via API route

### 10. PWA (Progressive Web App)
- Fully installable on Android (Chrome/Edge) and iOS (Safari Add to Home Screen)
- Offline-ready with cached core routes (/, /dashboard, /manifest.json)
- App-like experience: no browser chrome, splash screen, standalone mode
- Service worker versioned for cache busting on updates

---

## Target Audience

- Small and medium solar vendors in India (1–20 member teams)
- Solar EPC companies executing CSPDCL rooftop solar projects in Chhattisgarh
- Solar entrepreneurs in tier-2 and tier-3 cities (Raipur, Bilaspur, Durg, Korba, and beyond)
- Channel partners and freelancers managing rooftop solar leads for DISCOM schemes
- Any solar business replacing spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups with a structured system
